extension.description: Unofficial Kodi add-on for browsing and playing movies and series from LRT Epika, the Lithuanian National Radio and Television streaming service. Requires Kodi 20 or newer. DRM titles use inputstream.adaptive with Widevine.
Neoficialus Kodi papildinys LRT Epikos filmams ir serialams žiūrėti. Reikalingas Kodi 20 ar naujesnis. DRM turiniui naudojamas inputstream.adaptive ir Widevine.
extension.disclaimer: This add-on is not affiliated with or endorsed by LRT. All streamed content belongs to LRT. Some titles are geo-restricted or require Widevine DRM.
